en: I have run through these plains for many, many seasons.  And I have hunted great beasts.  And I had never been bested... until I faced Ghost Howl.$B$BLong ago, the massive wolf was an ally to the tauren and fought bravely against the Burning Legion.  But he was wounded savagely by a demon, and the tear in his flesh never healed.  Eventually... it drove Ghost Howl mad.$B$BNow he roams the plains in agony, seeking an end to his pain.  To my shame, when we fought I lacked the strength to slay him...
